findings.title: The fused rampart makes mercy time-bounded
findings.claim: The focus names the completed barrier as mercy and places its engineered protection inside a bounded interval that ends when the appointed promise levels it.
findings.mechanism: The pericope supplies the gap, barrier, materials, alignment, fire, coating, and two failed entry routes; the focus words for mercy, promise, and leveling contact that completed construction and turn the closing statement into a time-bounded protection reading.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the mercy can be effective now and destined to be leveled later: its protective work has a designed interval.
findings.containment: The ordinary statement remains that the barrier is mercy from the Lord and that the Lord's true promise will level it; the construction-to-closure synthesis is a contextual resonance, not a claim about every use of these roots.

epistemic.reason: Exact pericope occurrences and focus returns are supplied, while the cross-word synthesis remains a trusted channel nomination rather than an independent lexical adjudication.
